offers_products.reason: Main offerings are testing, inspection, certification and engineering services; proprietary software is only a minor add-on.

offers_services.reason: Testing, inspection, certification, compliance, NDT and engineering design services for critical assets are its core business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are industrial, energy, utility, infrastructure and building owners, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves industrials, energy processing, utilities, public and commercial infrastructure and data center owners.

recurring_revenue.reason: Recurring inspection, testing and compliance work for asset owners drives much of the revenue, though engineering is project-based.

cyclical_demand.reason: Regulated inspection, integrity testing and maintenance compliance are hard to postpone; engineering design is somewhat more cyclical.

big_ticket.reason: Inspection and testing jobs are routine, repeated service engagements rather than large, infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for technicians', inspectors' and engineers' time and expertise; the work would stop without staff.

large_customers.reason: Main clients are large industrial, energy, utility and public-sector infrastructure owners, plus data center operators.

asset_heavy.reason: A people-based inspection and engineering services firm that needs labs, equipment and offices, not heavy plants or fleets.

notes: Parent of Acuren and NV5; the engineering and design part is more project-based, while inspection is recurring.
